notes.title: New feature: nutrition
notes.notes:
Introducing a new feature: nutrition
It can be unlocked at the fruit upgrades, in the garden.
It gives you a capacity to use in battle, to use biomass to add directly 10-20-30-40 or 50 (depending on skill upgrade) more ripening.
It allows you to haste games when you are able to manage high damages and biomass gain... but use it with care too! :)

Fix missing descriptions and add hover tooltip for speed buttons.

Fix the special skill of the 3rd flower, "pollen expansion". It now makes what it was designed for: the pollen skill cost more but is more powerful, to have to use it less but for a greater effect!

notes.title: Flowers change, balance and polish
notes.notes:
[h3]Flowers feature changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]To make flowers use more relevant, the base price has been downed from 40 to 20
[*]Insect spawn is now a manual skill, letting players choose whether want challenge or not
[*]The flying insect "Sweety" is no more invoked by the Apetizer plant, but is now one of the possible insect called by the new active skil
[*]The Apetizer has changed to become the Necrophagia, its special is now a chance to convert dead ennemies around into biomass
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*]The increase rate of upgrades, in the garden, has been re-upped
[*]The special power of the Gobbler can't be upgrade no more than level 4, giving, at max upgrade, 40% chance to produce 5 biomass
[*]The Chewer no longer slows down its targets
[*]Slow down conditions can no longer stop ther targets. Only specials having this particular trait, like the rooter one, can really stop the Nibblers
[*]Upgrades refunded
[*]To let the player choose a mutation by use and not price, all mutations of the same tier cost the same price to buy and upgrade
[/list]

[h3]Fix and add[/h3]
[list]
[*]Add stats, in the garden upgrade menus: damage over time (called "conditions"), the number of conditions applied by each attack and the time it remains
[*]Fix a bug that made the biomass number wasn't updated when using it in pause
[*]Fix a bug that prevent the challenge menu to be properly shown and updated, on main map, when you unlock a new challenge level
[*]Add a new model modification, on the Nibblers spawn, which correspond to the challenge level
[/list]

notes.title: The challeng update!
notes.notes:
[h2]The challenge update![/h2]
Today, a global upgrade of the Sacrifice Tree, in the Garden:
[list]
[*]Modification of the Nibblers bodies number bar, for a more comprehensive feature and a better look
[*]Adding a visual effect, at the bottom of the Sacrifice tree and in the Sacrifice menu, to show up the corpses consume skill is ready to use
[*]Upgrading the corpses stock is cheaper
[*]Increasing the number of cells earned by consuming the corpses
[*]Adding difficulty unlock buttons, that need corpses to be unlocked
[*]As soon as you'll unlock the first difficulty upgrade, the button for difficulty choice for level 1 and 2 will appear
[/list]

[h3]Levels of difficulty[/h3]
[list]
[*]Level 1 : Base difficulty, no modification
[*]Level 2 : The creatures get stronger over time, in addition to normal difficulty increase. Cells reward +10%
[*]Level 3 : More difficulty increase and new creatures and new creatures appear. Cells reward +20%
[*]Level 4 : Nibblers are, again, more powerful and the Overlords come into battle!. Cells reward + 30%
[*]Add one new creature for level 3: Slugiciola, a bulky Nibbler that spread slime that spead up creature getting on it
[*]Add one new creature for level 4: Overlord, a mighty Nibbler that walk slowly and spit mucus that  increase armor and max life of others creatures
[/list]
